name: Cash Deposit
definition: Amount of money representing a value paid by a debtor to an agent bank.

NoteDenomination.name: Note Denomination
NoteDenomination.definition: Specifies the note or coin denomination, including the currency, such as a 50 euro note.

NumberOfNotes.name: Number Of Notes
NumberOfNotes.definition: Specifies the number of notes of the same denomination in the deposit.

DepositAmount.name: Deposit Amount
DepositAmount.definition: Specifies the total amount of money in the cash deposit, that is the note denomination times the number of notes.

RelatedBankingTransaction.name: Related Banking Transaction
RelatedBankingTransaction.definition: Describes the type of transaction associated with a cash deposit.
